Hi {{ $json.full_name.split(' ')[0] }},

nodes.notes: Swap the body per trigger_state — see n8n/templates.md. Or add a Switch on trigger_state upstream.

nodes.notes: Production: use Query Parameters ($1..) instead of inline expressions. See n8n/sql/transition_handler.sql.

=

Thank you — we've got what we needed. Your lawyer will pick things up and we'll email you the moment there's an update.

nodes.name: Send confirmation email
nodes.notes: Pick template_key = confirm_<payload.from>. See n8n/templates.md → Confirmations.

parameters.query:
insert into notifications (will_id, lead_id, trigger_state, channel, source, sequence_step, template_key, sent_at)
values ('{{ $json.body.record.will_id }}', '{{ $json.body.record.lead_id }}', '{{ $json.body.record.payload.from }}', 'email', 'system', 'confirmation', 'confirm_{{ $json.body.record.payload.from }}', now());
